photos.desc: Indian Pangolin kept in cage before it released in forest at Gujarat, India

On display at the Royal Armouries, Leeds. Photographed by Gaius Cornelius on 08-Jun-06. Legend reads: Scale coat Indian, Rajasthan, early 19th century This coat has been covered with the scales of the
Indian pangolin , thick-tailed pangolin or scaly anteater (Manis crassicaudata) foetus in the Hunterian Museum at the Royal College of Surgeons of England.
